description: Source code implementing repository functions for managing runs and attempts, including creating, listing, retrieving, and updating them, with integration to external storage for assets.

methods.name: AssetRef _augment_with_signed_url(ref: AssetRef)
methods.description: Enriches an AssetRef with a signed URL if storage is configured and URL can be generated.

methods.name: AssetRef _to_asset_ref(a: Asset)
methods.description: Converts an Asset object to AssetRef, augmenting with signed URL if applicable.

methods.name: AttemptStatus _to_attempt_status(a: Attempt)
methods.description: Converts an Attempt object to AttemptStatus with attached assets.

methods.name: str _aggregate_run_status_from_attempts(attempts: List[Attempt])
methods.description: Determines overall run status from a list of attempts.

methods.name: RunStatus _to_run_status(r: Run)
methods.description: Converts a Run object to RunStatus, including attempts and assets.

methods.name: Run create_or_get_run(session: Session, run: Run, notification: Optional[NotificationTarget])
methods.description: Creates a new run or retrieves an existing one if correlation key matches.

methods.name: Tuple[List[RunStatus],int] list_runs(session: Session, page: Optional[int] = None, per_page: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of runs with pagination support.

methods.name: Optional[RunStatus] find_run_by_correlation_key(session: Session, ckey: Optional[str])
methods.description: Finds a run by its correlation key.

methods.name: AttemptStatus create_attempt( session: Session, run_id: str, types: List[str], correlation_key: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Creates a new attempt associated with a run, with idempotency via correlation key.

methods.name: Optional[AttemptStatus] get_attempt(session: Session, run_id: str, attempt_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an attempt by run_id and attempt_id.

methods.name: Tuple[List[AttemptStatus],int] list_attempts(session: Session, run_id: str, page: Optional[int] = None, per_page: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Lists attempts for a specific run, with pagination.

methods.name: AttemptStatus update_attempt_status_and_assets( session: Session, attempt_id: str, status: str, message: Optional[str], started_at: Optional[datetime], finished_at: Optional[datetime], assets: List[AssetRef], )
methods.description: Updates attempt status, timestamps, assets, and refreshes run's aggregated status.
